blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public prosecutor and Manila Rep. Joel Chua accused Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers of setting up a defense that is more of a Korean drama (K-drama), claiming that they are trying to gain sympathy from the people instead of addressing pressing issues. In a press briefing on Thursday, Chua said the two defense witnesses who testified before the Senate Impeachment Court earlier were geared for the social media content of Duterte’s team, rather than addressing unexplained wealth allegations raised by the prosecution under Article II of the Articles of Impeachment.
